current_flow: Every recorder and gate resolves task-scoped artifacts by joining factory_dir(root) with hard-coded names (decomposition.json, grills/tasks/<id>.json, tests.json, reviews/<aspect>.json, verify.json); pr_ready later MOVES the whole set into .factory/history/<story>/. Two concurrent stories therefore write identical paths and every overlapping PR conflicts; the move also triggers rename detection across branches. Nothing reads .factory/stories/ today.

criteria_map.new-story artifacts record under .factor: test_new_story_artifacts_record_under_story_dir intakes a story under the new layout marker and asserts every recorder lands its artifact in the story dir via the shared helper
criteria_map.legacy live and history layouts remain r: test_legacy_layout_stays_readable_by_every_consumer replays a legacy fixture and asserts gates, board data, and history read the old paths unchanged

new_abstractions: story_dir(root, key) and evidence_path(root, key, name) in factory_lib - no existing helper owns evidence layout; ad-hoc joins across seven consumers are exactly the fork risk. Reversible: pure path resolution, legacy fallback keeps every old artifact readable.
